reviews.text: I noticed a large amount of yellow jackets coming in and out of a hole in the brick mortar underneath the porch roof. I also noticed a few bees in my basement and found a large paper nest above the electrical panel which was very active.
reviews.author: D R.

reviews.text: Brad came out the day after I called him during the end of September. We had JUST moved into a house and one of the bedrooms was being taken over by yellow jackets. It was so stressful and haulted our move in process. Luckily Brad took care of it so quickly.
reviews.author: Monica R.

reviews.text: A swarm of something took up residence under the foundation of my house, entirely too close for comfort to the front door. After spaying a can and a half of wasp Raid at the problem with no results, as a Hail Mary I called Main Street Pest Control at 11:35am...
reviews.author: Whitney M.
